claim: This exact revision satisfies NUI v8 deterministic structural and contract checks for 174 canonical skill graph/depth coverage, agent interoperability, external-skill supply-chain trust, visual-media provenance, creative tool routing, inherited v5-v7 enforcement and the v8 adversarial corpus.
bounds: Structural verification does not prove every future UI is beautiful, usable, accessible, lawful or superior; task-specific rendered evidence and human/product outcomes remain separate.
Agent bridges alter discovery/invocation only. Host sandbox, permissions, MCP approvals and tool availability remain authoritative.
External agent skills are untrusted instruction/code supply-chain inputs until immutable revision, content, license, capabilities and adoption boundary are reviewed.
Publicly accessible images are not automatically reusable. Material assets require asset-level rights/provenance verification and relevant privacy/publicity/trademark or cultural-sensitivity review.
Geometry is not banned. Shape substitution is blocked only when generic abstraction displaces higher-information subject-native media/data or pretends to encode evidence it does not possess.

Creative tools execute bounded stages; they do not decide product truth or grant themselves authority. Generated/sourced assets still require rendered integration, accessibility, performance and rights evidence.
Repository adversarial cases are executable specifications, not a universal cross-model or human-preference benchmark.
unknowns: Live vendor agent paths, tool capabilities, service terms and external asset rights can drift and require current verification when material.
Cross-model visual preference and product-specific usability outcomes remain outside repository-only CI unless separately measured.
